key=medical count=196 positions=[1698145, 1698861, 1698913, 1699042, 1699119, 1699149, 1699177, 1699220, 1699234, 1699333, 1700636, 1710240]

tem
  // 14 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // then repeat.
  // This makes public-health statistics and medical news much more visible.

  if (isAdminNotice && tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
    renderTickerCard('admin', conciseTickerText(rawItem, 105), 6500);
    return;
  }

  const cycleStep = rotasticContentCycleIndex % 15;
  rotasticContentCycleIndex = (rotasticContentCycleIndex + 1) % 15;

  if (cycleStep === 0 || cycleStep === 7) {
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 1 || cycleStep === 5 || cycleStep === 10) {
    rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount += 1;

    // Keep the stream focused on public-health numbers. Qatar fun facts remain
    // occasional rather than replacing a quarter of the medical-stat slots.
    const stat = chooseWeightedMedicalStat();
    if (stat) {
      renderTickerCard('stat', stat, 6000);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 2) {
    const prayerMessage = getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes);
    if (prayerMessage) {
      renderTickerCard('prayer', conciseTickerText(prayerMessage, 98), 6000);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 3 || cycleStep === 8 || cycleStep === 12) {
    rotasticCpdSlotCounter += 1;
    if (rotasticCpdSlotCounter % 4 === 1) {
      const cpdEvent = chooseActiveCpdEvent();
      if (cpdEvent) {
        rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = cpdEvent.link;
        rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'CPD event', domain:(new URL(cpdEvent.link)).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'')};
        renderTickerCard('medicalnews', cpdEvent.text, 7600);
        return;
      }
    }

    const medicalHeadline = chooseLatestMedicalHeadline();

    if (medicalHeadline) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', medicalHeadline, 6500);
      return;
    }

    // This branch should be rare because chooseLatestMedicalHeadline also has
    // trusted-source landing-page fallbacks.
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 4) {
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 6 || cycleStep === 14) {
    renderCentreIdentityCard();
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 9) {
    const headline = chooseWorldHeadlineWithSource();

    if (headline) {
      renderTickerCard(headline.type, headline.text, 6300);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 11) {
    const weatherUpdate = getActualDohaWeatherTickerText();
    if (weatherUpdate && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0) {
      rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta = {name:'Doha Weather', domain:'open-meteo.com'};
      renderTickerCard('general', weatherUpdate, 7800);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 13) {
    const evidenceItem = (tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0)
      ? (chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() || chooseNhsRelevantHeadline())
      : (chooseNhsRelevantHeadline() || chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem());
    if (evidenceItem) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', evidenceItem, 8200);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
}

function renderQuietShiftTicker() {
  renderNextTickerSlot();
}

let headlineTickerTimer = null;
let headlineTickerPhase = 'stream';




const ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
const rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt = Date.now();
let rotasticRoomHeroTimer = null;

function getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor() {
  const doctor = activeUserDocName || getSplashDoctorName();
  const day = getTodayScheduleDay();

  if (!doctor || !day) return null;

  const timing = getDoctorShiftTiming(day, doctor);
  if (!timing) return null;

  const shift = day[timing.period];
  if (!shift) return null;

  const rooms = getRoomAssignmentsForDoctor(shift, doctor);
  if (!rooms.length) return null;

  return {
    rooms: rooms,
    period: timing.period,
    shiftLabel: timing.label,
    day: day
  };
}

function renderMainRoomHero() {
  const card = document.getElementById('mainRoomHero');
  const number = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroNumber');
  const context = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroContext');
  if (!card || !number || !context) return;

  const remaining = ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS - (Date.now() - rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt);
  const info = getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor();

  if (remaining <= 0 || !info) {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  number.textContent = info.rooms.join(' / ');
  context.textContent =
    info.rooms.length === 1
      ? info.shiftLabel + ' • keep this room in mind for your first part of the shift'
      : info.shiftLabel + ' • multiple room allocations today';

  card.classList.remove('hidden');

  if (rotasticRoomHeroTimer) clearTimeout(rotasticRoomHeroTimer);
  rotasticRoomHeroTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
  }, remaining);
}

  'Wishing you a good shift with no unnecessary surprises.',
  'Hope your day is smooth, manageable and rewarding.',
  'Wishing you a calm start and an even calmer finish.',
  'Hope today is one of those pleasantly easy shifts.'
];

    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 3 || cycleStep === 8 || cycleStep === 12) {
    rotasticCpdSlotCounter += 1;
    if (rotasticCpdSlotCounter % 4 === 1) {
      const cpdEvent = chooseActiveCpdEvent();
      if (cpdEvent) {
        rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = cpdEvent.link;
        rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'CPD event', domain:(new URL(cpdEvent.link)).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'')};
        renderTickerCard('medicalnews', cpdEvent.text, 7600);
        return;
      }
    }

    const medicalHeadline = chooseLatestMedicalHeadline();

    if (medicalHeadline) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', medicalHeadline, 6500);
      return;
    }

    // This branch should be rare because chooseLatestMedicalHeadline also has
    // trusted-source landing-page fallbacks.
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 4) {
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 6 || cycleStep === 14) {
    renderCentreIdentityCard();
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 9) {
    const headline = chooseWorldHeadlineWithSource();

    if (headline) {
      renderTickerCard(headline.type, headline.text, 6300);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 11) {
    const weatherUpdate = getActualDohaWeatherTickerText();
    if (weatherUpdate && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0) {
      rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta = {name:'Doha Weather', domain:'open-meteo.com'};
      renderTickerCard('general', weatherUpdate, 7800);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 13) {
    const evidenceItem = (tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0)
      ? (chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() || chooseNhsRelevantHeadline())
      : (chooseNhsRelevantHeadline() || chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem());
    if (evidenceItem) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', evidenceItem, 8200);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
}

function renderQuietShiftTicker() {
  renderNextTickerSlot();
}

let headlineTickerTimer = null;
let headlineTickerPhase = 'stream';




const ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
const rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt = Date.now();
let rotasticRoomHeroTimer = null;

function getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor() {
  const doctor = activeUserDocName || getSplashDoctorName();
  const day = getTodayScheduleDay();

  if (!doctor || !day) return null;

  const timing = getDoctorShiftTiming(day, doctor);
  if (!timing) return null;

  const shift = day[timing.period];
  if (!shift) return null;

  const rooms = getRoomAssignmentsForDoctor(shift, doctor);
  if (!rooms.length) return null;

  return {
    rooms: rooms,
    period: timing.period,
    shiftLabel: timing.label,
    day: day
  };
}

function renderMainRoomHero() {
  const card = document.getElementById('mainRoomHero');
  const number = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroNumber');
  const context = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroContext');
  if (!card || !number || !context) return;

  const remaining = ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS - (Date.now() - rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt);
  const info = getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor();

  if (remaining <= 0 || !info) {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  number.textContent = info.rooms.join(' / ');
  context.textContent =
    info.rooms.length === 1
      ? info.shiftLabel + ' • keep this room in mind for your first part of the shift'
      : info.shiftLabel + ' • multiple room allocations today';

  card.classList.remove('hidden');

  if (rotasticRoomHeroTimer) clearTimeout(rotasticRoomHeroTimer);
  rotasticRoomHeroTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
  }, remaining);
}

function getOpeningBriefingData() {
  const rotatingGreetingVibe = nextGreetingVibe();
  const profile = activeUserDocName || getSplashDoctorName();
  const context = getRotasticGreetingContext(profile);
  const today = getTodayScheduleDay();

  if (!profile) {
    return {
      hasProfile:false,
      greeting:context.standardGreeting,
      detail:'Please choose your physician profile below to personalise your rota, drive time and notifications.',
      room:'',
      roomNumbers:[],
      clinics:[],
      emergency:[],
      codeBlue:[],
      shiftLead:'',
      shiftLabel:'',
      holiday:context.holiday
    };
  }

  if (!today) {
    return {
      hasProfile:true,
      greeting:context.standardGreeting,
      detail:getRotasticShiftWish(),
      room:'',
      roomNumbers:[],
      clinics:[],
      emergency:[],
      codeBlue:[],
      shiftLead:'',
      shiftLabel:'',
      holiday:context.holiday
    };
  }

  const timing = getDoctorShiftTiming(today, profile);
  const briefing = chooseSingleDailyBriefing(today, profile);

  if (!briefing || !timing) {
    return {
      hasProfile:true,
      greeting:context.standardGreeting,
      detail:'There is no published duty entry for you today. Enjoy the breathing space ☕🙂',
      room:'',
      roomNumbers:[],
  

---
 else if (data.clinics && data.clinics.length) {
    roomLabel.textContent = 'CLINIC';
    roomValue.className += ' opening-rota-room-value-clinic';
    roomValue.textContent = cleanClinicLabelForSentence(data.clinics[0]);
  } else {
    roomLabel.textContent = 'TODAY';
    roomValue.textContent = 'DUTY';
  }

  roomHero.appendChild(roomLabel);
  roomHero.appendChild(roomValue);

  top.appendChild(copy);
  top.appendChild(roomHero);
  wrap.appendChild(top);

  const details = document.createElement('div');
  details.className = 'opening-rota-briefing-details';

  function addBriefingItem(iconClass, label, value, accentClass) {
    if (!value) return;
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'opening-rota-detail-item ' + (accentClass || '');

    const icon = document.createElement('i');
    icon.className = iconClass;

    const body = document.createElement('div');
    const labelEl = document.createElement('div');
    labelEl.className = 'opening-rota-detail-label';
    labelEl.textContent = label;

    const valueEl = document.createElement('div');
    valueEl.className = 'opening-rota-detail-value';
    valueEl.textContent = value;

    body.appendChild(labelEl);
    body.appendChild(valueEl);
    item.appendChild(icon);
    item.appendChild(body);
    details.appendChild(item);
  }

  addBriefingItem(
    'fa-solid fa-user-shield',
    'Shift lead',
    data.shiftLead || 'Not assigned',
    'detail-lead'
  );

  if (data.codeBlue && data.codeBlue.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-heart-pulse',
      'Code Blue',
      data.codeBlue.join(' · ').replace(/[💙⚡]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-codeblue'
    );
  }

  if (data.emergency && data.emergency.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-truck-medical',
      'Emergency responsibility',
      data.emergency.join(' · ').replace(/[🚑🧸]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-emergency'
    );
  }

  if (data.clinics && data.clinics.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-stethoscope',
      'Clinic',
      data.clinics.join(' · ').replace(/[👶🤰🩺😷👂🚭🌸]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-clinic'
    );
  }

  wrap.appendChild(details);
  content.appendChild(wrap);

  rememberRotasticTickerItem(
    'greeting',
    [
      data.greeting,
      data.room,
      data.codeBlue?.join(' '),
      data.emergency?.join(' '),
      data.shiftLead ? 'Shift lead: ' + data.shiftLead : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' — ')
  );

  const duration = Math.max(1700, Number(totalDurationMs || 2200));
  if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
  headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode', 'ticker-personal-rota-briefing');
    renderNextTickerSlot();
  }, duration);

  scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
  return true;
}

function renderOpeningTypewriterBriefing(data, totalDurationMs, recurring, persistent) {
  rotasticTickerLastRenderAt = Date.now();
  // On true app opening, show a compact personal rota briefing with a very
  // prominent room/clinic assignment plus Code Blue, emergency and shift lead.
  // Recurring greeting slots remain the lighter good-vibes treatment.
  // Opening sequence uses one typewriter greeting only. Personal duty details remain in Personal View.


  if (recurring && data) {
    const freshVibe = nextGreetingVibe();
    if ('positiveMessage' in data) data.positiveMessage = freshVibe;
    if ('wish' in data) data.wish = freshVibe;
    if ('message' in data && !('positiveMessage' in data) && !('wish' in data)) {
      data.message = freshVibe;
    }
    if ('detail' in data && freshVibe) {
      data.detail = freshVibe;
    }
  }

  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!ticker || !content) return;

  setTickerFullWidthMode(false);
  ticker.classList.add('ticker-greeting-mode');
  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');
  content.innerHTML = '';
  setTickerBadge('greeting', data.greeting || 'Greeting');

  if (!rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing) {
    rememberRotasticTickerItem(
      'greeting',
      [data.greeting, data.detail].filter(Boolean).join(' — ')
    );
  }

  const hero = document.createElement('div');
  hero.className = 'ticker-opening-hero';

  const copy = document.createElement('div');
  copy.className = 'ticker-opening-copy';

  const greeting = document.createElement('div');
  greeting.className = 'ticker-opening-greeting';
  greeting.textContent = data.greeting || 'Good day, Doctor';

  const detail = document.createElement('div');
  detail.className = 'ticker-opening-detail';

  const cursor = document.createElement('span');
  cursor.className = 'ticker-typewriter-cursor';

  copy.appendChild(greeting);
  copy.appendChild(detail);
  hero.appendChild(copy);
  content.appendChild(hero);

  // Keep the animated line concise enough to fit cleanly in two lines.
  const detailText = String(data.detail || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

  let index = 0;
  const chars = Array.from(detailText);
  const total = Math.max(4200, Number(totalDurationMs || 5000));
  const typingBudget = Math.min(1150, Math.max(650, chars.length * 14));
  const delay = chars.length
    ? Math.max(14, Math.min(38, typingBudget / chars.length))
    : 20;

  const finishGreeting = function() {
    if (persistent) return;

    const elapsedTyping = chars.length * delay;
    const hold = Math.max(900, total - elapsedTyping);

    if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
    headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() {
      ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode');
      renderNextTickerSlot();
    }, hold);
  };

  const typeNext = function() {
    if (index >= chars.length) {
      if (cursor.parentNode) cursor.remove();
      finishGreeting();
      return;
    }

    detail.textContent += chars[index++];
    detail.appendChild(cursor);
    headlineTickerTimer = setTi
